title: Crispy Roast Beef with Crumbly Topping
description: A twist on traditional roast beef, served with a crunchy crumbly topping. This dish is a perfect blend of flavors and textures, sure to impress your family and friends.

ingredients.name: Roast beef chuck
ingredients.notes: Choose a chuck roast with a good amount of marbling

ingredients.name: Earthly herbs
ingredients.notes: Use a combination of thyme, rosemary, and oregano

ingredients.name: Flaky pastry
ingredients.notes: Make sure to thaw the pastry first

ingredients.name: Crumbles
ingredients.notes: You can use a store-bought crumble mix or make your own

ingredients.name: Sesame oil
ingredients.notes: Use a good quality sesame oil for the best flavor

ingredients.name: Soy sauce
ingredients.notes: Use a low-sodium soy sauce for a healthier option

ingredients.name: Brown sugar
ingredients.notes: Use a high-quality brown sugar for the best flavor

ingredients.name: Ginger
ingredients.notes: Use fresh ginger for the best flavor

ingredients.name: Garlic
ingredients.notes: Use fresh garlic for the best flavor

ingredients.name: Salt
ingredients.notes: Use kosher salt for the best flavor

instructions: Season the roast beef with earthy herbs, salt, and pepper.
Heat the sesame oil in a large Dutch oven over medium-high heat. Sear the roast beef until browned on all sides.
Transfer the roast beef to the preheated oven and roast for 20 minutes per pound.
While the roast beef is cooking, prepare the crumbly topping by mixing together the crumbles, brown sugar, ginger, and garlic.
After the roast beef has cooked for 20 minutes, remove it from the oven and brush the crumbly topping all over the top.
Return the roast beef to the oven and continue cooking for an additional 10-15 minutes, or until the crumbly topping is golden brown.
Remove the roast beef from the oven and let it rest for 10-15 minutes before slicing.
Serve the roast beef with the crumbly topping and your favorite sides.
